title: Implementation of Universal Access Initiative for People with Disabilities in Dammam
summary: Makkah Newspaper reports on the implementation of a universal access initiative for people with disabilities in the Dammam capital. The initiative focuses on creating an inclusive environment and ensuring accessibility in public spaces and services for individuals with disabilities.
body:
Makkah Newspaper reports on the implementation of a universal access initiative for people with disabilities in the Dammam capital. The initiative focuses on creating an inclusive environment and ensuring accessibility in public spaces and services for individuals with disabilities.
